source.author: verg
source.text: Tum sic exspirans Accam ex aequalibus unam alloquitur fidam ante alias, quae sola Camillae, quicum partiri curas; atque haec ita fatur:
source.text_original: Tum sic exspirans Accam ex aequalibus unam / alloquitur fidam ante alias, quae sola Camillae, / quicum partiri curas; atque haec ita fatur: /
source.text_english: Then, breathing her last, she thus addresses Acca, one of her equals, faithful above the rest, who alone shared Camilla’s cares; and she speaks as follows:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, fatur et haec:
reuse.text_original: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, / obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, / fatur et haec:
reuse.text_english: Only that one, raging, stands in the way with women’s howls, as much as the Martian trumpet drowns the Idaean boxwood pipe; and she says this:
